Four shots of two severed heads hanging.

Udal carrying the head of Kiria.
Long shot of Udal putting head at mother's feet.

Sidhanti being chased and thrashed inside the temple.

Nagoji's drunken entering and his chasing Santha in the Saranalayam are to be cut except for a suggestion at the beginning and showing Santha's escape at the end.

The evidence given by the approver.

The part of the dialogue where Lili says, 'I am not particular about getting married. You can come as often as you like and we can enjoy together'.
The part of the dialogue where Chintu tells his sister Sarala that she will have to show everything to the Doctor.
The part of the scene where Sarala is shown drawing a cross on the rice.
All scenes of kissing between Sarala and Sadashiv including the one in reel 7 where he is shown extinguishing lights and counting the number of kisses in the dark.

Delete all picturisation of Postmaster tampering with the Mail except for the story. (There is no objection to references in the dialogue).

In Reel 10, delete the dialogue between Jayachandran and Pulavar, 'Are you afraid that Delhi will invade?', 'Even if Delhi invades there is strength enough to defeat.'

Reduce the sound, picture and inserts relating to Velan being flogged.

Court scene, delete (a) the picture of the prosecutor walking in the court during his address; (b) their relevant conversation, sarcastic comment and laughter by the prosecutor, leaving only questions relating to the case, and (c) the Judge in one judgment sentencing the postmaster to death and releasing Velan. (There is no objection if the postmaster's trial for the crime and Velan's release, are referred to as separate).
